name: memory-canary
description: A regression test for agent memory isolation: plant a canary in one session's memory and fail the build if another session's agent retrieves it.
author: Max Millien

scripts.example:safe: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dist/examples/in-memory/adapter-safe.js
scripts.example:leaky: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dist/examples/in-memory/adapter-leaky.js
scripts.example:test:leaky: npm run build && MEMORY_CANARY_LEAK=cross-session node --test dist/examples/in-memory/*.test.js
